note: Official Blooket product updates. Dates from Blooket announcements and community wiki records. Times are UTC when known; day-level events use 12:00:00Z.

entries.title: Season 8 launches
entries.body: Season 8 goes live with Dog Pack (25 tokens), Claw Mania (live), Snake Escape (solo), Class Pass rewards, Achievements, Locker, and Arcade. Student experience redesigned.

entries.title: Fuego Unique available
entries.body: Fuego (Design a Blook Contest winner) appears in Market as a limited Unique from about May 20 to June 2, 2026.

entries.title: Design a Blook Contest
entries.body: Design a Blook Contest runs; Fuego later ships as the winning Unique.

entries.title: Major Market redesign
entries.body: Market UI overhaul: smaller pack icons, price under packs, multi-buy flow. Instant-open removed. Pack backgrounds and open animations updated.

entries.title: Season 7 — Mining
entries.body: Season 7 Class Pass. New gamemodes: Busy Bees, Mini Mine, Zorblitz, Star Grazer. Lunch Pack added to Market. Pirate's Voyage removed. Settings updates; Tag or Treat returns.

entries.title: Crazy Kingdom rework
entries.body: Crazy Kingdom gets a visual/UI rework aligned with other modes (confetti, settings).

entries.title: Blooks page redesign
entries.body: Blooks page updated (including Blook points display). Hidden section labeling briefly changes then reverts within days.

entries.title: Season 6 — Retro
entries.body: Season 6 Class Pass. New modes: Laser Tag, Study, Plushie Panic, Coco Cabana / Cocoa Cottage, Pirate Pool. Bug Pack and Autumn Pack (yearly). Reworks to Racing, Deceptive Dinos, Crazy Kingdom, Factory, Cafe. Tower of Doom removed. New login page; Blooks UI update.

entries.title: Crazy Kingdom bonus removed
entries.body: Extra token/XP bonus on Crazy Kingdom is removed.

entries.title: Season 5 — Pirate
entries.body: Season 5 Class Pass. Pirate Pack and Pirate's Voyage gamemode. Contest of Candy 2023.

entries.title: October 2022 visual redesign
entries.body: Site-wide redesign (Ben): cleaner UI, new Market look, new pack open animations by rarity, Weekly Shop for banners/titles, redesigned token art.

entries.title: Season 4 — Monsters
entries.body: Season 4. Boxes renamed to Packs. Ice Monster Pack, Monster Brawl, Tower Defense 2. Poster art for gamemodes. Weekly Shop rotation. Contest of Candy 2022. Daily Wheel later replaces older token multiplier.

entries.title: Season 3 — Aquatic
entries.body: Season 3. Aquatic Pack and Fishing Frenzy. Tower Defense map Abandoned Mine. Question UI improvements (image zoom, read-aloud, feedback). Stats page redesign. Contest of Candy 2021. Class Pass begins this era.

entries.title: Crazy Kingdom released
entries.body: Solo mode Crazy Kingdom launches (Season 2 period).

entries.title: Season 2 — Breakfast
entries.body: Season 2. Breakfast Pack. Cafe, Gold Quest, Crazy Kingdom era modes, Cyber Hack, Tower Defense, Santa's Workshop. First Contest of Candy (2020).

entries.title: Season 1 / site launch
entries.body: Blooket launches. Medieval, Bot, and Space packs. Early gamemodes including Classic, Racing, Tower of Doom, Snowball Fight, and Factory.
